rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for ordinary spoken “maybe,” including both possibility and a neutral noncommittal reply.

example.english: Maybe he won't go to work today.
example.jyutping: ho2 nang4 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this common alternative when presenting something as a possibility or giving a tentative “maybe” reply.

example.jyutping: waak6 ze2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that something is possible, rather than giving only a bare neutral “maybe.”

example.traditional: 呢個計劃有可能成功㗎。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1 gaa3
